name: Sync Program Member Data
summary: Updates program member custom fields (e.g. registration codes, webinar URLs) for leads that are already in the program. One row per lead.
whenToUse: When you have per-person data for program members — registration codes, seat assignments, notes — and want to store it on their program membership.

body.hint: One row per lead. leadId is required in every row; add a column for each program member field to set (API names — see 'Describe Program Member'). Only fields marked updateable can be written.

response.description: Per lead: updated or skipped (e.g. 'Membership not found' when the lead isn't in the program).

notes: The lead must already be a member of the program — this call does not add members (use Set Program Member Status first if needed).
Only fields with updateable=true can be set; standard fields like statusName are managed by the status call.
